bullets.text: Voice Feature Retiring Soon - **OpenAI** will remove ChatGPT's Voice feature from macOS on January 15, 2026.
AirPods Live Translation Expands - **Apple**'s iOS 26.2 update brings Live Translation to more EU users.
Google's App Store Fees - Developers face new fees of $2–4 per install for linking to external app downloads.
Resolve AI Hits $1 Billion - Startup **Resolve AI** achieves a $1 billion valuation with Series A funding.
Cisco Customers Vulnerable - Hundreds of **Cisco** customers are at risk from a new hacking campaign.
OpenAI Updates Teen Safety - New guidelines aim to protect minors using **ChatGPT** amid rising scrutiny.
Netflix Acquires Avatar Company - **Netflix** buys **Ready Player Me** to enhance its gaming avatar capabilities.
Yann LeCun Launches Startup - AI pioneer **Yann LeCun** announces his new venture, **Advanced Machine Intelligence**.
Cursor Acquires Graphite - AI coding assistant **Cursor** expands its capabilities by acquiring **Graphite**.
Krafton Launches $670M Fund - **Krafton** aims to invest heavily in India's gaming sector with a new fund.
